search-field.job: Enter and clear a search query without promising suggestion selection.
search-field.decision: Promote an Input recipe only when it owns clear and submit behavior; keep autocomplete in Combobox.
search-field.interaction: React Aria documents search submission and clearing; preserve ordinary text editing. Async result announcements belong to the consuming search view.

password-field.job: Enter a secret with an accessible visibility control.
password-field.decision: Reuse Input and Field; include a named reveal action and an optional strength/help slot.
password-field.interaction: GOV.UK recommends allowing paste and password-manager autocomplete. Mantine exposes controlled reveal and focusability; reveal must preserve the entered value.

multi-select.job: Choose several existing options from a constrained collection.
multi-select.decision: Share collection and popup behavior with Combobox; distinguish count summary from removable tokens.
multi-select.interaction: Base UI documents multiple selection, async search and virtualization. Mantine documents filtering, selected-value limits and backspace removal. Creation belongs to TagPicker.

tag-picker.job: Select or create removable text tokens.
tag-picker.decision: Build on the MultiSelect collection contract plus Chip removal; keep creation and tokenization opt-in.
tag-picker.interaction: React Aria documents tokenization and suggestions. Chakra/Ark adds delimiters, paste, blur behavior and editable tags; Fluent specifies deletion behavior.

editable-text.job: Switch a displayed value into an editor and commit or cancel it.
editable-text.decision: Share one primitive between inline body text and InlineEditableTitle; support single-line and multiline editors.
editable-text.interaction: Chakra/Ark documents activation and submit modes. Atlassian exposes explicit save/cancel controls and whether editing survives blur; these are separate choices.

otp-input.job: Enter a verification code in visually separated slots.
otp-input.decision: Keep one form value while offering grouped slots, separators and masking; do not build separate unrelated inputs.
otp-input.interaction: Base UI and Ark document controlled values, completion and paste/navigation behavior. Expose invalid and disabled states without disabling normal copy/paste assistance.

file-upload.job: Choose or drop files and review acceptance and upload state.
file-upload.decision: Compose a file trigger, drop target and file rows. Transport, virus scanning and persistence stay in the product adapter. The shadcn preview card is a visual analogue: its Browse button has no upload handler and is excluded from implemented-family counts.
file-upload.interaction: React Aria covers file triggers and drop targets; Chakra documents multiple files, directory selection, media capture and paste. GOV.UK lists concrete rejection/error cases.

form-validation.job: Coordinate field validation, submission errors and recovery.
form-validation.decision: Reuse Field errors; add a form contract and linked ErrorSummary rather than a new visual input.
form-validation.interaction: React Aria distinguishes native and ARIA validation. GOV.UK's error summary links to erroneous controls; preserve values after unsuccessful submission.

date-field.job: Edit a date by named locale-aware segments, with text-entry alternatives distinguished.
date-field.decision: Build the segmented primitive before DatePicker; keep GOV.UK's separate day/month/year inputs as an alternative recipe.
date-field.interaction: React Aria documents locale calendars, granularity, bounds and segment editing. GOV.UK uses individually labelled date fields; a mask is not the same interaction.

date-picker.job: Choose one date using a field or trigger and a calendar popup.
date-picker.decision: Compose Calendar, DateField and Popover; offer an explicit modal presentation for constrained layouts.
date-picker.interaction: React Aria supplies date/overlay behavior and validation. Mantine documents modal versus popup presentation; Material distinguishes docked, modal-calendar and text input.

date-range-picker.job: Choose and review start and end dates as one range.
date-range-picker.decision: Share DatePicker pieces; define complete versus partial ranges and optional preset selection separately.
date-range-picker.interaction: React Aria distinguishes contiguous and noncontiguous ranges. Ant exposes separate endpoint constraints; Untitled UI and Chakra document presets.

time-field.job: Edit a time of day with locale and precision controls.
time-field.decision: Separate time-of-day from duration; offer segmented entry and a selectable time list.
time-field.interaction: React Aria documents hour cycle, granularity and time-zone display. Mantine documents stepped segments, paste and time presets. A time list is a distinct anatomy.

duration-input.job: Edit elapsed time without calendar or time-zone semantics.
duration-input.decision: Reuse NumberField and InputGroup; use Mantine's duration mode as the concrete baseline.
duration-input.interaction: Mantine TimePicker explicitly documents duration type and minimum hour digits. React Aria TimeField is an analogue, not evidence of elapsed-duration semantics.

link.job: Navigate with inline text, standalone text or an icon-supported label.
link.decision: Use native anchor behavior and shared text roles; avoid a second Button implementation.
link.interaction: React Aria documents router integration and disabled links. Fluent and Carbon distinguish inline versus standalone use; destinations and link names remain meaningful.

pagination.job: Move through a bounded set of result pages or a sequence of content pages.
pagination.decision: Compose Buttons/Link plus optional page-size control; keep page index and total in product state.
pagination.interaction: GOV.UK distinguishes content-page navigation from item-page navigation. Carbon and Ant expose page-size selection; Mantine documents URL synchronization.

stepper.job: Communicate progress through named stages and optionally navigate between them.
stepper.decision: Treat stage status separately from whether a stage is actionable; reuse Buttons and Progress.
stepper.interaction: Mantine exposes next-step selection limits and keyboard navigation. Chakra demonstrates validation gates; Apple's numeric stepper is a different job and is not counted.

menubar.decision: Extend Menu behavior through a horizontal command strip; do not duplicate menu items.
menubar.interaction: Base UI and Mantine document menubar keyboard behavior and shared menu composition. Preserve focus movement across menus and dismissal back to the invoking trigger.

listbox.job: Select values from an always-visible option collection.
listbox.decision: Own focus, selection and typeahead independently of a popup; reuse it in MultiSelect and TransferList.
listbox.interaction: React Aria documents selection, layouts and drag/drop. Ark supports extended selection and keyboard priority; interactive row actions require a grid-style list contract.

selectable-list.job: Present selectable rows that may also contain independent actions.
selectable-list.decision: Use a distinct collection contract when a row has nested controls; compose Avatar and Checkbox slots.
selectable-list.interaction: Fluent distinguishes selection as primary versus secondary action and list/listbox/grid roles. React Aria GridList supports row actions, selection and drag/drop.

tree-select.job: Choose values from a hierarchy in a popup or cascading columns.
tree-select.decision: Reuse TreeView and Combobox; separate tree-with-checkboxes from column-by-column cascading selection.
tree-select.interaction: Mantine TreeSelect distinguishes single, multiple and checkbox modes. Ant Cascader documents change-on-select and lazy loading; parent/child selection rules need an explicit contract.

transfer-list.job: Move selected options between source and destination collections.
transfer-list.decision: Compose two ListBoxes with named move actions and optional per-side filters.
transfer-list.interaction: Ant exposes direction, selected keys, search and paging. Chakra has a Transfer List example; movement is distinct from selecting a row.

rating.job: Enter or display a score using repeated symbols.
rating.decision: Separate read-only display from editable selection and expose optional fractional values.
rating.interaction: Mantine documents fractional ratings and custom symbols. Ark documents keyboard selection; Ant exposes clearing and half values.

toggle-button-group.job: Group pressed command buttons or choose a mutually exclusive mode.
toggle-button-group.decision: Reuse ButtonGroup and Segmented; add the missing selection contract instead of another track renderer.
toggle-button-group.interaction: Base UI and React Aria support single/multiple pressed sets. Radix Themes SegmentedControl is a single-choice analogue within the family, not evidence of multiple selection.

drag-handle.job: Expose reordering as an explicit action with a visible insertion target.
drag-handle.decision: Reuse PropertyList for local reorder; adopt an adapter for cross-list or tree movement.
drag-handle.interaction: React Aria documents keyboard drag/drop. Atlassian recommends accessible move menus, announcements and focus restoration as an alternative to pointer dragging.

accordion.job: Reveal sections while keeping headings scannable.
accordion.decision: Factor a standalone Disclosure, then a group with single/multiple expansion; reuse Panel section anatomy.
accordion.interaction: Mantine documents arrows, Home/End and Enter/Space. GOV.UK advises against disabled sections; Base UI additionally offers hidden-until-found panels.

drawer.job: Present a contextual side or bottom surface with an explicit modality contract.
drawer.decision: Compose existing Dialog and Panel; add edge placement, modal/nonmodal behavior and optional resize/snap behavior.
drawer.interaction: Fluent distinguishes inline and overlay drawers. Material and Apple distinguish modality and dismissal; Base UI and Ark expose swipe-related drawer behavior.

alert-dialog.job: Require an explicit response to an important or destructive decision.
alert-dialog.decision: Add a behavior specialization to Dialog, with cancel and confirm actions; keep urgent tone separate from size.
alert-dialog.interaction: Fluent has an alert modal type. Radix/Base UI provide AlertDialog action/cancel semantics; prevent accidental dismissal according to the chosen contract.

splitter.job: Resize adjacent regions using a shared boundary.
splitter.decision: Extend Panel resizing into a multi-region container with min/max and collapse constraints.
splitter.interaction: Ark documents keyboard resize, collapse and resize indicators. Mantine supports multiple panes; shadcn delegates to react-resizable-panels.

scroll-area.job: Keep overflowing content scrollable with optional custom scrollbar presentation.
scroll-area.decision: Retain native scrolling semantics and opt into custom bars only where needed.
scroll-area.interaction: Mantine documents axis selection and controlled scroll position. Ark documents keyboard behavior and hover/always visibility; Apple provides platform scroll conventions.

responsive-layout.job: Arrange components in rows, stacks and responsive grids.
responsive-layout.decision: Add layout primitives with shared gap/alignment semantics; keep density system-wide.
responsive-layout.interaction: Radix, Mantine and Polaris expose layout primitives. These do not create their own selection or dismissal contract; child controls keep normal keyboard order.

page-header.job: Group page identity, context, navigation and actions.
page-header.decision: Compose Breadcrumb, title/description and action slots; avoid a separate control behavior.
page-header.interaction: Primer explicitly exposes context, title, breadcrumbs, description and navigation areas. Polaris exposes page actions; keyboard behavior comes from composed links/buttons.

sidebar.job: Provide grouped application navigation with optional compact presentation.
sidebar.decision: Compose Nav and Menu, then expose expanded, collapsed and overlay structures.
sidebar.interaction: shadcn documents sidebar variants and collapse behavior. Fluent describes secondary actions and grouping; Apple documents platform sidebar expectations.

app-shell.job: Coordinate navigation, header, content and supporting panes.
app-shell.decision: Offer recipes built from Sidebar, PageHeader and Panel; do not bake application routing into layout.
app-shell.interaction: Mantine distinguishes fixed/static shell behavior and responsive navbar/aside collapse. Primer provides resizable panes and responsive fullscreen layouts.

dockable-inspector.job: Move or resize an inspector while retaining its editing context.
dockable-inspector.decision: Start with a floating/resizable Panel recipe; defer a full docking engine until an owner workflow exists.
dockable-inspector.interaction: Ark FloatingPanel and Mantine FloatingWindow document dragging and resizing. Their presence does not establish docking trees, tabbed docking or persistence.

description-list.job: Pair labels and values without imposing table navigation.
description-list.decision: Provide semantic term/value anatomy with inline/stacked layouts and optional row actions.
description-list.interaction: Radix and Chakra expose orientation. GOV.UK summary lists add per-row and card actions; editing remains the responsibility of those controls.

stat.job: Display a key quantity with context and optional change indication.
stat.decision: Compose Card, text and status roles; animation is an optional behavior, not another semantic family.
stat.interaction: Ant Statistic documents number formatting and timer-related components. Chakra Stat provides labels, values and trends; avoid making static values interactive.

timeline.job: Show ordered events with markers, metadata and optional actions.
timeline.decision: Offer simple, alternating and compact layouts; reuse Avatar/Badge/Separator.
timeline.interaction: Primer exposes actions and breaks; Ant exposes orientation and item placement. Static timelines keep document reading order and do not imply listbox selection.

empty-state.job: Explain why a collection or workflow has no content and offer the next action.
empty-state.decision: Compose icon/illustration, title, description and actions; distinguish empty, filtered-empty and first-use content.
empty-state.interaction: Untitled UI documents icon, illustration and avatar structures. Primer and Polaris provide primary/secondary actions; focus stays with the initiating workflow.

result.job: Explain a completed outcome or blocking error at page or section scale.
result.decision: Reuse Alert and EmptyState pieces with explicit success/error content and recovery actions.
result.interaction: Ant Result enumerates outcome and HTTP-error presentations. GOV.UK Panel is a confirmation composition; it is not evidence for every error state.

banner.job: Present a persistent page or section announcement.
banner.decision: Follow Area's existing decision to extend Alert layout rather than add a competing primitive.
banner.interaction: Fluent documents stacking, collapse and dismissal. Polaris provides dismissible banners and actions; GOV.UK separates notification and cookie-decision banners.

meter.job: Show a bounded measurement rather than task completion.
meter.decision: Share Progress's track rendering while keeping meter semantics and value text separate.
meter.interaction: Base UI and React Aria provide meter semantics and bounds; do not infer indeterminate or loading behavior from Progress.

circular-progress.job: Show completion on a ring or gauge.
circular-progress.decision: Extend Progress with circular anatomy; preserve Spinner as the separate unknown-duration indicator where appropriate.
circular-progress.interaction: Material documents determinate/indeterminate modes and transitions. Mantine adds segmented rings and semicircles; Chakra supplies value labels.

notification-queue.job: Manage several transient status messages over time.
notification-queue.decision: Keep Toast rendering; add a queue/manager with update, dismiss, placement and visible-limit policies.
notification-queue.interaction: Base UI documents promise, deduplication and stacking. React Aria covers dismissal and announcements; Chakra exposes pause/play and maximum-visible controls.

data-grid.job: Navigate, select and manipulate structured data beyond a static table.
data-grid.decision: Adopt a collection engine and reuse Table styling; build selection/sorting before editing and virtualization.
data-grid.interaction: React Aria documents keyboard navigation, resize and drag/drop. shadcn's recipe uses a table engine; Fluent exposes focus modes. Not every table source includes cell editing.

tree-grid.job: Combine hierarchical expansion with columns or row actions.
tree-grid.decision: Build after DataGrid and TreeView contracts; nested rows alone do not establish full treegrid semantics.
tree-grid.interaction: Fluent Tree exposes tree/treegrid navigation modes. Ant supports nested table data; Atlassian TableTree supplies hierarchical table anatomy. Record engine differences explicitly.

media-preview.job: Inspect an image or playable media with preview controls.
media-preview.decision: Compose Dialog for images and delegate media playback to an adapter.
media-preview.interaction: Ant Image exposes preview transforms and toolbar customization. Untitled UI supplies video-player layouts; Atlassian's viewer is a separate media integration.

carousel.job: Browse a sequence of cards or media through a constrained viewport.
carousel.decision: Separate arrow/dot navigation, axis, item sizing and autoplay; reuse Card content.
carousel.interaction: Ark documents keyboard navigation, autoplay, pause-on-hover and drag. Fluent distinguishes card/banner/gallery layouts; Material documents multi-browse, hero and fullscreen alternatives.

rich-text-editor.job: Edit structured prose using a mature document model.
rich-text-editor.decision: Provide an adapter plus Area toolbar/menu skins; avoid a superficial contenteditable implementation.
rich-text-editor.interaction: Chakra documents Tiptap integration, bubble menus, mentions and slash commands. Atlassian publishes an editor model and annotation APIs; define serialization and undo boundaries per adapter.

code-editor.job: Edit source code with language-aware behavior.
code-editor.decision: Choose an editor engine before offering language, completion or diagnostics options. JSON text entry is only a narrow analogue.
code-editor.interaction: Mantine JsonInput documents validation/formatting for JSON; Primer's Markdown switch is internal. A full code-editor contract was not found in the reviewed core catalogues.

charts.job: Render quantitative information through a themed chart engine.
charts.decision: Offer engine adapters with shared legend/tooltip roles and accessible alternatives; do not create a new plotting engine. Fluent evidence is its v9 charts package; Atlassian evidence is its Forge UI Kit chart extension, not an Atlaskit core chart. Availability is source-observed, not a release audit.
charts.interaction: shadcn and Mantine wrap chart engines. Carbon supplies chart families; Apple documents chart interpretation. Interaction, brushing and keyboard support are engine-specific.

gradient-editor.job: Edit color stops and gradient geometry.
gradient-editor.decision: Extend ColorPicker through a stop-list/track composition; reuse ColorSwatch and NumberField.
gradient-editor.interaction: Untitled UI documents adding/removing stops, angle and gradient types. Ant ColorPicker exposes a gradient mode; its existence does not imply all gradient geometries.

easing-curve-editor.job: Edit the timing function used by an animation.
easing-curve-editor.decision: Defer a native curve editor until a reference contract and engine are selected.
easing-curve-editor.interaction: No dedicated editor was found in the reviewed systems. Material motion source is only an interpolation analogue; draggable control points and numeric handles remain Area proposals.

shortcut-recorder.job: Capture a keyboard chord and explain conflicts.
shortcut-recorder.decision: Reuse Kbd for display but design capture, cancellation and conflict validation as a new behavior.
shortcut-recorder.interaction: Primer documents displaying sequences/chords; Apple documents keyboard conventions. Neither is evidence of a shipped recorder, reserved-key policy or conflict resolver.

toggletip.job: Reveal supplementary interactive information on explicit activation.
toggletip.decision: Compose Button and Popover; retain Tooltip for noninteractive hover/focus labels.
toggletip.interaction: Carbon distinguishes toggletips from tooltips. Chakra exposes Escape/outside dismissal; Fluent InfoLabel documents focus treatment for the supplemental content.

message-actions.job: Expose actions associated with one conversation turn.
message-actions.decision: Use Message's existing actions slot and Button/Toolbar; offer persistent and contextual placement as recipes.
message-actions.interaction: shadcn Message documents actions and accessible icon labels. Untitled UI includes multiple message-action examples; service operations remain application callbacks.

thinking-disclosure.job: Reveal progress or reasoning-related content in a conversation.
thinking-disclosure.decision: Compose Disclosure, Message and Spinner; keep elapsed-time logic outside the visual primitive.
thinking-disclosure.interaction: No dedicated timed thinking disclosure was found. shadcn suggests reasoning content inside Message; Ark/React Aria disclosure behavior is a reusable analogue.

source-chip.job: Identify a citation and optionally preview its destination.
source-chip.decision: Compose Chip/Link and HoverCard; keep citation numbering and provenance in product data.
source-chip.interaction: No dedicated citation-pill family was found. Untitled UI's message link previews and Radix HoverCard are anatomical references, not citation semantics.

attachment-card.job: Represent a file or image with metadata, upload status and actions.
attachment-card.decision: Compose Card and Progress with separate preview and remove targets.
attachment-card.interaction: shadcn documents idle/uploading/processing/error/done, horizontal/vertical layouts and independently focusable actions. Untitled UI includes message attachments.

voice-input.job: Record spoken input while making progress and cancellation clear.
voice-input.decision: Defer recording to a media adapter; reuse Composer and Button for the surrounding UI.
voice-input.interaction: No dedicated recorder was found. Untitled UI's message-audio presentation is playback evidence only; permission, capture, transcription and waveform behavior remain unspecified.

emoji-picker.job: Choose an emoji or icon from a searchable categorized collection.
emoji-picker.decision: Build a searchable selection recipe; keep emoji-specific tone/recent data separate from generic icon selection.
emoji-picker.interaction: Atlassian publishes emoji picker configuration and types. Chakra shows an emoji grid and editor insertion; Primer's autocomplete is internal evidence only.

callout.job: Emphasize a block of document content with an optional icon.
callout.decision: Reuse Alert's paint/spacing roles while preserving document semantics; tone and alert announcements are separate choices. Carbon Callout is a source-stage renamed notification component; its source marks a future move to stable. Deprecated kind aliases are not proposed new tones.
callout.interaction: Radix Callout exposes treatment, color and alert role examples. GOV.UK inset text is a quieter structure; Atlassian adds semantic section-message appearances.

toggle-block.job: Hide optional content inside flowing document text.
toggle-block.decision: Use Disclosure as a document recipe, with nested blocks only where the content model supports them.
toggle-block.interaction: GOV.UK Details documents short optional content; Ark documents nested and partial collapse. A disclosure does not automatically implement document editing or block drag/drop.

people-picker.job: Find and select people with identifying metadata.
people-picker.decision: Compose Combobox, Avatar and Chip; keep inviting and account lookup in the product adapter.
people-picker.interaction: Atlassian UserPicker provides a dedicated implementation. Fluent TagPicker supports a secondary action; generic token fields are only reusable collection evidence.

reactions.job: Toggle an emoji response and show aggregate participation.
reactions.decision: Compose Chip/Button with the EmojiPicker; keep server counts and optimistic reconciliation external.
reactions.interaction: Atlassian publishes reaction types and controls. Untitled UI includes message reactions; disabled/loading and add-reaction affordances need explicit state wiring.

comment-thread.job: Show discussion identity, body, metadata, replies and actions.
comment-thread.decision: Use Avatar, Composer and Message recipes with the product owning permissions and persistence.
comment-thread.interaction: Atlassian Comment exposes nested children and action/metadata slots. Untitled UI supplies message reply examples; threading depth is a content-model choice.

floating-format-bar.job: Offer text-formatting commands near a selection.
floating-format-bar.decision: Reuse Toolbar and Popover with the editor adapter retaining the text selection.
floating-format-bar.interaction: Untitled UI documents floating-toolbar sizes. Chakra's bubble-menu example anchors commands to editor selection; focus movement must preserve that selection.

database-card.job: Show a record as a card with typed properties and optional media.
database-card.decision: Compose Card and PropertyValue; defer board-specific drag and editing to a collection adapter.
database-card.interaction: No dedicated typed database-card contract was found. Primer Card's metadata and action slots are the closest documented anatomy.

property-value.job: Render and optionally edit a typed record property.
property-value.decision: Use a renderer registry that maps existing Area controls to property types; avoid a universal untyped cell.
property-value.interaction: No dedicated cross-type property registry was found. React Aria Table and Ant Descriptions provide container analogues, not a typed-value data model.

color-area.job: Select two color channels in a spatial control.
color-area.decision: Expose the existing ColorPicker area only if independent composition is required.
color-area.interaction: React Aria documents axis channels and keyboard editing. Fluent provides ColorArea types; Ark exposes area/thumbnail parts within its picker.

color-slider.job: Adjust one color channel along a linear track.
color-slider.decision: Expose shared ColorPicker channel behavior while preserving the color model and accessible value text.
color-slider.interaction: React Aria documents channels and orientation. Ark exposes channel sliders; a general numeric Slider alone does not supply color interpretation.

eyedropper-button.job: Sample a color from outside the picker when the platform supports it.
eyedropper-button.decision: Offer an optional ColorPicker action with an explicit unavailable state and manual-entry fallback.
eyedropper-button.interaction: Mantine ColorInput and Ark ColorPicker expose eyedropper controls. Browser support and user-activation requirements must be checked when implementing the adapter.

scrubbable-angle.job: Adjust an angular value using a dial and optional numeric entry.
scrubbable-angle.decision: Reuse NumberField for exact values; add a dial only where circular manipulation is useful.
scrubbable-angle.interaction: Mantine AngleSlider documents marks, change-end and radial movement. Ark AngleSlider exposes steps and a hidden input; this is stronger evidence than a generic slider.

zoom-control.job: Set a viewport magnification and invoke fit/reset commands.
zoom-control.decision: Compose NumberField, Menu and Button; the canvas or viewer owns the transform.
zoom-control.interaction: No standalone percentage/fit/reset family was found. Ant Image documents zoom transforms, but that viewer API is only an analogue for a design-canvas zoom control.

layer-row-badges.job: Identify a layer's role or state inside a tree row.
layer-row-badges.decision: Use TreeView trailing slots and Badge; do not add a second tree renderer.
layer-row-badges.interaction: Fluent explicitly documents badges and quick actions in tree rows. Primer exposes trailing visuals; component/instance/mask meanings are Area product data.

constraints-picker.job: Select independent edge constraints rather than one alignment point.
constraints-picker.decision: Compose CheckboxGroup in a spatial recipe; keep it distinct from AlignmentPicker's exclusive selection.
constraints-picker.interaction: No dedicated edge-constraint picker was found. CheckboxGroup provides independent selection semantics only; pinning relationships require a new product contract.

unit-field.job: Edit a numeric value together with its unit or sizing mode.
unit-field.decision: Compose NumberField, InputGroup and Select; unit conversion and auto/fill semantics belong to the domain.
unit-field.interaction: Mantine documents numeric prefixes/suffixes and Untitled UI documents input dropdowns. Polaris MoneyField has currency semantics; it is a narrow unit-aware example.

font-picker.job: Find a font family and optionally choose a weight or style.
font-picker.decision: Compose Combobox and Select; font loading, preview content and variable axes belong to an adapter.
font-picker.interaction: A dedicated preview/weight-aware FontPicker was not found. Rich-text formatting toolbars are analogues, not evidence of font discovery or variable-font support.

variable-chip.job: Show that a field is bound to a design variable and allow detachment.
variable-chip.decision: Compose Code/Chip/Tooltip with explicit binding state; the token resolver owns lookup and validity.
variable-chip.interaction: No dedicated bound-variable chip was found. Radix Code and Ark TagsInput supply visual/removal analogues; neither establishes token binding semantics.

keyboard-shortcuts.job: Show discoverable keyboard commands grouped by task.
keyboard-shortcuts.decision: Compose Dialog/Sheet and Kbd groups; command search is an optional recipe after CommandPalette.
keyboard-shortcuts.interaction: Primer documents sequences/chords and shadcn documents KbdGroup. Apple provides keyboard conventions; a dedicated searchable shortcut overlay was not found.
